title: Curro training plan (v1)
description: A running training plan leading up to one target race. Plans are written as weeks of days rather than calendar dates: the LAST entry in `weeks` is race week (the Monday-to-Sunday week that contains `race.date`), and every earlier week is counted backwards from it. Days that are not listed are rest days.

$schema.description: Optional URL of this schema, for editor tooling.

schemaVersion.description: Always 1 for this version of the schema.

name.description: Short plan title, e.g. "12-week half marathon, sub 1:50".

description.description: Overview of the plan's approach, phases and key advice.

author.description: Who or what made the plan (a coach, "ChatGPT", "Claude", etc.).

units.description: Unit for every distance in this file (race distance and workout distances). Paces are per this unit.

distance.description: Race distance in `units` (e.g. 21.1 km or 13.1 mi).

goalTime.description: Target finish time, H:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS.

paces.description: Optional training paces (per `units`), used by the app to check that easy runs are really easy.

easy.description: Slowest end of easy is fine; this is the FASTEST easy runs should be.

weeks.description: Weeks in chronological order. The final week is race week.

workoutType.description: easy/recovery/long count as easy running; tempo/intervals/hills/fartlek/progression/race-pace/time-trial/race count as hard running; cross-training and rest are not running.

focus.description: Theme of the week, e.g. "Base", "Build", "Cutback", "Taper", "Race week".

days.description: At most one entry per weekday. Unlisted weekdays are rest days.

distance.description: Total distance in `units`, including warm-up and cool-down. Give a distance for every running day so weekly volume can be tracked.

durationMin.description: Optional duration in minutes (useful for cross-training).

description.description: Full instructions: warm-up, main set, recoveries, cool-down.
